text.p: Jakarta share prices are seen moving in narrow range trading on Tuesday, with profit-taking likely in selected big-caps following recent gains, brokers said.
"Players are likely to take profit because of a lack of fresh domestic leads and Wall Street's fall overnight," one broker said.

Selected big-caps Indocement, Barito and Sampoerna made modest gains on Monday on bargain-hunting, brokers said. They, however, said local buying in some small stocks was likely to continue due to speculation.

Small-sized property firm Elang Realty was among the most active on Monday and was likely to remain so on Tuesday due to market talk that the firm was expected to announce a rights issue, another broker said.
Conglomerate Astra International announced its audited 1996 results on Monday, but brokers said the results were not much different from its unaudited results announced earlier.
On Monday, the Jakarta composite index rose 4.67 points, or 0.73 percent, to close at 642.26 points.
